ECHO_CORE_HIDDEN_LIGHT.name: Hidden Light
ECHO_CORE_HIDDEN_LIGHT.description: A sonata set focused on recovery and death prevention.
ECHO_CORE_HIDDEN_LIGHT.breakpoint_2: 2 pieces: heal 1 HP at the start of combat.
ECHO_CORE_HIDDEN_LIGHT.breakpoint_5: 5 pieces: when you would take fatal damage, recover 1 HP instead.
ECHO_CORE_ENDLESS_ECHO.name: Endless Echo
ECHO_CORE_ENDLESS_ECHO.description: A sonata set built around repeated attacks.
ECHO_CORE_ENDLESS_ECHO.breakpoint_2: 2 pieces: gain 1 Strength at the start of combat.
ECHO_CORE_ENDLESS_ECHO.breakpoint_5: 5 pieces: when you play an Attack, if there are no other Attacks in your hand, play it again.
